overview.title: Your experience. A clearer next step.
overview.subtitle: ATS Coach AI
overview.narration: Your experience deserves a clear introduction. ATS Coach AI helps you understand how your background fits a role, prepare your application, and practice the conversation. Explore the complete workflow with an interactive sample.

overview.title: One application workspace
overview.subtitle: A connected path through preparation
overview.narration: Bring a resume and a target job. Review the evidence behind the match, edit your resume and cover letter, prepare application answers, and practice interviews. Each step keeps your own experience at the center.
steps: Understand the match
Edit your documents
Prepare answers
Practice interviews

overview.title: The evidence behind the match
overview.subtitle: Exact evidence, related experience, and gaps
overview.narration: The diagnosis explains what your resume supports. Separate exact matches from related experience and missing requirements. Use the educational score as a starting point for review. It does not predict a hiring decision.
overview.note: Anonymized sample. Educational estimates do not predict hiring outcomes.

overview.title: Documents you can make your own
overview.subtitle: Direct editing with fonts, spacing, and PDF review
overview.narration: Click into the document canvas to edit your text. Adjust the font, spacing, and margins, then review the PDF. A matching cover letter gives you another starting point that you can revise in your own voice.

overview.title: Application answers with evidence
overview.subtitle: A suggestion you can inspect and revise
overview.narration: Prepare answers using your saved materials. Type a question or dictate it, then review a grounded suggestion and its supporting evidence. Unsupported details prompt a request for information instead of invented experience.
overview.note: Prepared sample answer shown. Live AI actions use your submitted materials.

overview.title: Interview practice with text and voice
overview.subtitle: Spoken questions and editable answer transcripts
overview.narration: Hear a question through your speakers. Respond by typing or speaking into your microphone, then review the transcript before submitting. Live practice adds feedback and follow-up questions, with your latest application materials as context.

overview.title: Useful for individual and guided preparation
overview.subtitle: Job seekers, coaches, universities, and client demos
overview.narration: Job seekers can prepare independently. Coaches and university programs can guide a review using the same explained workflow. Save the application workspace locally, download the files you approve, and keep a separate set for each role.
overview.note: Workspace files contain your application materials. Store them with care.

overview.title: Thank you
overview.subtitle: Try the interactive sample
overview.narration: See how the workflow fits your next application. Open ATS Coach AI and choose Explore the interactive sample. Use the walkthrough whenever you need help. You review the facts and choose what to share. Thank you.

guide.title: Your first application workspace
guide.subtitle: A clear walkthrough of ATS Coach AI
guide.narration: Welcome to ATS Coach AI. This walkthrough follows the real app using anonymized sample materials. You will see the diagnosis, editable documents, application answers, and interview voice controls, then learn how to save your work.

guide.title: The interactive sample
guide.subtitle: A prepared example you can explore immediately
guide.narration: Choose Explore the interactive sample on the welcome screen. It opens a prepared diagnosis and documents without waiting for live AI. The sample banner stays visible so you can distinguish example content from a personalized live response.
steps: Choose Explore the interactive sample.
Review the sample label before continuing.

guide.title: Your resume and target role
guide.subtitle: Live analysis begins with your own materials
guide.narration: For a real application, choose Start with my own resume. Paste resume text or upload a PDF, then paste the job description. Remove private identifiers before sending materials to AI. Analyze Match begins the live comparison.
steps: Paste resume text or upload a PDF.
Add the target job description.
Select Analyze Match for a live diagnosis.

guide.title: The match diagnosis
guide.subtitle: The explanation matters more than the number
guide.narration: Review the match diagnosis and its evidence. Exact matches quote your resume. Related experience explains a connection without treating it as an exact skill claim. Missing requirements identify gaps. The scores are educational estimates, so check the details yourself.
steps: Review exact and related evidence separately.
Treat missing requirements as gaps to review.
Use the score as an educational estimate.

guide.title: The application workspace
guide.subtitle: Four sections keep your preparation together
guide.narration: Choose Open sample workspace in the example, or Generate Tailored Resume after live analysis. The workspace contains Resume, Cover letter, Application Q and A, and Interview Coach. Switch sections to continue working without losing a draft within these tabs.
steps: Open the workspace after diagnosis.
Use the four section buttons to move between tools.

guide.title: The resume canvas
guide.subtitle: Direct text editing and document formatting
guide.narration: Open Edit Resume Canvas. Click the text you want to change, then use the toolbar for font size, spacing, and margins. Long content wraps inside the document. Select Done Editing to save your changes, then review the resulting PDF.
steps: Open Edit Resume Canvas and click the text.
Adjust formatting with the toolbar.
Select Done Editing and inspect the final PDF.

guide.title: The matching cover letter
guide.subtitle: A starting point you can revise
guide.narration: Switch to Cover letter. Generate a letter from your application materials, or explore the prepared sample letter. Open its canvas to revise the text and formatting. Check the company, role, and factual claims before downloading your approved PDF.
steps: Open Cover letter.
Review the role, company, and facts.
Edit the letter and download the approved PDF.

guide.title: Application questions and answers
guide.subtitle: Text or voice input with evidence to review
guide.narration: In Application Q and A, type a question or select an example. Hear Question reads it aloud. Dictate Question uses your microphone. You can also record an answer draft, edit the transcript, and request a grounded suggestion with supporting evidence.
steps: Type or dictate a question.
Type or record an answer draft.
Review the suggestion and its evidence before sharing.

guide.title: The interview practice session
guide.subtitle: A question tailored to your application materials
guide.narration: Open Interview Coach and choose a practice type. Start the interview. The question appears as text and can play aloud automatically. Hear Question repeats it. Choose Slower, Natural, or Faster to adjust the speaking pace.
steps: Choose a practice type and start.
Use Hear Question to repeat the question.
Set the speaking pace to suit you.

guide.title: Your spoken answer becomes editable text
guide.subtitle: You control what reaches the AI
guide.narration: Select Start Recording and allow microphone access if prompted. Speak your answer, stop recording, and correct the transcript. Only Submit Answer sends that text for feedback. The sample shows prepared feedback, while live practice evaluates the answer you submit.
steps: Hear the question
Speak or type an answer
Review the text
Submit for feedback

guide.title: Microphone access
guide.subtitle: Browser and Windows permissions both matter
guide.narration: If recording is unavailable, open the published app in its own Chrome tab. In the address bar site controls, allow the microphone. In Windows Privacy and security, enable microphone access for desktop apps. Reload only after saving your workspace. Text entry always remains available.
steps: Chrome site controls: Microphone → Allow
Windows: Privacy & security → Microphone
Enable microphone and desktop app access
Save your workspace before reloading

guide.title: Saving and reviewing your work
guide.subtitle: Separate workspaces for separate roles
guide.narration: Name the application and choose Save workspace. Keep the downloaded JSON file, then use Open workspace to restore inputs, diagnosis, documents, and formatting. Download application answers and interview notes separately. The checklist helps you review facts and final PDFs before sharing.
steps: Name the application and save the workspace file.
Download answers and interview notes separately.
Review facts and final PDFs with the checklist.

guide.title: Thank you
guide.subtitle: You are ready to explore your next application
guide.narration: You have seen the complete preparation workflow. Return to the interactive sample whenever you want to explore, or start with your own resume and target role. Use How to use to reopen this guide. Review the facts and choose what to share. Thank you.
